verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://vuejs.org/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured Vue.js table of contents (Getting Started, Introduction, ...), so a user can point an agent at it directly. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt or agent-oriented docs offering, evidence of fuller agent-oriented variants (e.g., a full-content llms file or per-page markdown), and independent or community corroboration of agent use.
